name: Nagata Maiko
source: Maiko is [url=https://vndb.org/c63689]Takuya[/url]'s underclassman from high school. She is kind of a strange girl that acts very cutesy and has a rather clingy personality. Poor Maiko is often the target of unwanted affection by many perverted guys and because of that she had turned herself towards lesbianism for love and support. Ever since she met Takuya in his [url=https://vndb.org/c63690]girl form[/url] one day at one of the public bathhouses, she instantly became attracted to him (her) and she will be constantly trying to do anything that's in her power to seduce Takuya.
